Devlog #1.3: Hidden-face Culling - YNL - Vozel (Devlog) by Yunasawa
Sep 10, 2025Hidden-face culling is a technique to reduce the number of faces in a voxel mesh by removing those that are completely hidden (adjacent to another voxel). This greatly reduces the total number of vertices and triangles that need to be rendered. 🔶 The Original Approach When generating the mesh for a voxel, I checked each of its six faces.
